main_text.l: Rigare, vid. Aspergere. Rigatio, vid. Aspersio.

Rigens] Rigidus, Ovid. Torpens, Virg. Obtorpuit manus, Cic. Callosus, Col. Torpidus stupore ac miraculo. Sopitus humerus, Liv. Abalienata morbis membra praecidunt medici, Quint. Instupens membrum, Plin.
Rigidè, parùm civiliter] Ex Syngraphâ agere. Morosissimè penitare, Suet.

Rigidè procedere] Summo jure agere, Cic. Præter æquum & bonum, Ter. Gravius aliquid in aliquem statuere, Caes. Inclementius dictum, Ter. Tristius respondere, Cic. Illiberaliter factum, Ter. Præcisè, Cic. De apicibus juris disceptare, Vlp. Pro meo jure, Ter. Abscissè, Callistr.
Rigidus] Immite edictum, Ovid. Summum jus, summa injuria, Cic. Censorium judicium, Id. Priscus pater, Catul. Abscissus, Val. M. vid. Severus.
Rima] Vitium ædis, parietis. Fissus, Cic. Segmen & ruptura parietis, Vitr. Spiramentum, Virg. Fissum, Cels. Fissura, Col.
Rimosus] Fissus, Scissus, Col. Fisliculatus, Mart. Hiulcus, Virg. Bifidus. Bifidatus, Ovid. Plin. Fluxum pertusumque vas, Lucr. Futilis ac rimarum plenus, Apul.
Ringi] Hirrire, Carif. vid. Rictum diducere.
Ripa] Margo fontis, ripæ, Ovid. Margo fluminis, Var. Labrum fluminis, Sisen. Supercilium fluminis, Amm.
Risibilis] Ridendi facultate præditus, Sipont. Cachinnabilis, Apul.
Risus moderatus] Extra cachinnum risus. Sine dente sales, Mart.

Risus simulatus] Sardonius risus, Eras. ex Gr. ab herba Sardoa, quæ comesa rictus homini invito diducit, & contrahit ridentis speciem, nascitur in Sardiniâ, Virg. Alienis malis ridens, Hor. Errantesque genæ atque alieno gaudia vultu, Val. Arg.
Risui est mihi] Movet mihi risum. Risum vix teneo, Cic.

page.notes: Several words in the italic author abbreviations are doubtful, notably "Carif." and "Rictum" (printed "Riftum"), and "Fisliculatus" may be "Fisticulatus". The catchword "Risum" is at bottom right; the running head is "RI." with "ORI" partly visible above it.
